title: Intentset conformance case
description: One entry of tests/<section>.json. A case starts from a baseline repository tree (examples/<baseline>/), applies files, patches, sources and registries, and states what a conforming implementation reports. The published suite (@intentset/conformance-suite) carries the expanded form, with every patch already applied, so a consumer needs no patch logic.

name.description: Unique within the section. Catalog cases keep their catalog ID as a prefix, e.g. "C03 governedBy targets a capability".

baseline.description: A directory under examples/ whose files start the tree. Omit for a self-contained case built only from files.

files.description: Whole documents by repository-relative path. A null value deletes the baseline's file.

patch.description: Edits to baseline documents by path. For each: frontmatter edits keyed by dotted path into the YAML mapping (null deletes the key), and an optional body replacement.

registries.description: Replaces the baseline's registries.yaml content as a mapping; omitted keeps the baseline's.

sources.description: Non-document files (TypeScript sources, tsconfig, test output) by repository-relative path, for VSA and evidence cases.

config.description: The .intentset/config.yaml mapping; omitted uses the baseline's or a default scope of **/*.md.

carrier.description: How the documents are read (ADR 0003). plain reads frontmatter and headings without a Markdown parser and reports nothing of its own; markset reads them with a Markset parser, whose diagnostics pass through with origin syntax and Markset's codes (Core §11).

evidence.description: Run records (Core §8) supplied to the evidence check.

request.description: A publication request for publication cases.

ids.description: Knowledge IDs requested; omitted means every eligible one.

authorizedInternal.description: Explicit authorization for an internal projection (Core §9); omitted means not authorized.

authorizedRestricted.description: Explicit authorization for a restricted projection; omitted means not authorized.

valid.description: True when no diagnostic is an error.

diagnostics.description: Every diagnostic code the case must produce, errors and warnings, as a multiset. Omitted on a valid case means none. Intentset's codes are AREA###; a Markset diagnostic (origin syntax, only with the markset carrier) keeps Markset's own AREA_NAME code.

artifacts.description: Optional: the artifact IDs that must appear in the graph, sorted.

export.description: Optional: fields of the export envelope that must match (deep partial; generatedAt, commit and graphHash are compared only if named).

published.description: Optional, publication cases: knowledge IDs that must be published, text that must appear somewhere in the output, and text that must not appear anywhere in it.
